Step 1: This degree program requires a minimum of 72 semester hours of graduate coursework beyond the baccalaureate degree along with the development of a dissertation.

Step 3: No more than one week after the written examination, the student will take an oral qualifying examination. Both of these examinations will be administered by the student's advisory committee (consisting of at least three members of the graduate faculty).

Step 4: After completion of the dissertation, the student will present and defend a dissertation.

Introduction

We welcome you to Texas Tech online. Below are some of the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's) that we receive for Registration.

What is a time ticket?

This is a specific date and time window that is assigned to you that will allow you to register for classes. You can find your Time Ticket by following the steps below:

Step 1: Login to Raiderlink (opens in new tab)

Link for "Login to Raiderlink (opens in new tab)": https://www.ttu.edu/it4students/raiderlink.php

Step 2: Navigate: Find and click on the "Add or Drop Classes" tool.

Step 3: Click on “Prepare for Registration”, this will show you your registration status information.

*If you cannot locate your time ticket or have an enrollment issue, contact your Online Student Advocate for assistance. You may also need to check for and resolve any "holds" on your account that could prevent registration.

Do I need to pay for the course certificate?

No, as your learning program is sponsored by Texas Tech, you can get course certificates at no charge.

Save Time & Money

Students who meet the eligibility criteria with a minimum of 80 applicable credit hours can potentially earn their bachelor's degree in just one year, with costs starting from as low as $10,000*

*Individual pricing will vary based on each student's transfer credit and prior learning experiences. Your advisor will assist you in estimating your total cost.

How much do the degrees cost?

Costs vary by program, but Online+ is designed to be competitive and transparent. https://www.depts.ttu.edu/online/affordable/.

What is the cost of the program?

Qualifying students have the opportunity to finish microcredential coursework at no cost and achieve their degree for as little as $10,000*.

*Individual pricing will vary based on each student's transfer credit and prior learning experiences. Your advisor will assist you in estimating your total cost.

Flexible Learning Schedule

Every student has unique obligations and responsibilities that have an impact on when and where they can engage in learning, but that shouldn't hold them back from earning a graduate degree. That's why you can attend our program as a full-time or part-time student and why most of the curriculum is offered with an asynchronous modality. Students in our online MSW program can mold study time to whatever schedule works best for them, from first thing in the morning all the way to the wee hours of nightime. Whatever time it is, your class materials will be waiting for you. On the other hand, we know from experience that most students want some face-to-face time to get to know their professors and peers, as well as to ask questions and get help. In the TTU Online MSW program, you'll have the option to drop-in during professors' real-time office hours and attend real-time meet-ups at least a few times each semester.

What are the funding options for the program?

The first four microcredential classes are free, as is credit for prior learning for eligible students. Students can pay a flat program fee to convert microcredentials and prior learning for credit and can then apply for scholarships, grants, and student financial aid.

What is the 10-k Degree Completion Program?

You have credits. You have experience. Now it is time to finish what you started. The Texas Tech $10K Degree Completion Program offers an affordable, flexible pathway to your bachelor's degree, with personalized one-on-one support every step of the way.

If you have at least 80 applicable credit hours (including all core courses completed), you could earn your degree for as little as $10,000*. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we will work with you to make your degree as affordable as possible.

Up to 21 Free Credit Hours* Available

*When you combine your prior learning credit with free microcredentials you can potentially earn up to 21 hours of credit towards degree completion at no cost. Once enrolled in online degree coursework, a simple flat program fee allows you to convert your prior learning for credit toward the $10K Degree Completion Program.

Two Distinct Program Admission Tracks

Online Advanced Admission:

Ideal for recent graduates of a CSWE-accredited baccalaureate program in social work, students in this program track begin in the summer and can complete their degree in just one calendar year of full-time* study.

Online Standard Admission:

Designed for applicants with undergraduate degrees in disciplines other than social work. Students in this program track begin in a fall semester and can complete their degree in two years of full-time* study.

*Students who need to remain employed, care for a family member, or fulfill other obligations during their degree program have the option to apply for either program admission track as a part-time student.

Assessment and Transfer Credit Evaluation

Embark on your educational journey with a personalized assessment, meticulously tailored to your prior work experience, transfer credits, and academic aspirations. Our commitment to recognizing your unique background extends to credit for prior work experience, offering you the opportunity to earn up to nine hours of credit towards your degree. An advisor will collaborate with you to review your past college credit and prior learning experience, guiding you through the creation of a prior learning portfolio for approval. In the $10K Degree Completion Program, this means when you combine your prior learning credit with free microcredentials you can potentially earn up to 21 hours of credit towards degree completion at no cost. Once enrolled in online degree coursework, a simple flat program fee allows you to convert your prior learning for credit toward your degree, streamlining your path to success.
